integrity: The four seed multiplicity vectors and the source's exact four-class theorem are used as published inputs. The augmentation by one copy of each point of \(\operatorname{PG}(1,4)\) is proved to preserve the Hermitian Gram matrix. The automorphism formula is reduced to multiplicity-block permutations and an exact enumeration of the \(60\)-element \(\operatorname{PGL}(2,4)\) action, replayed by a standalone verifier.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the four \([5s+3,2,4s+1]_4\) dimension-two Hermitian LCD classes with Hermitian-dual distance at least \(2\) arising from Proposition 4.13. It determines group orders but not abstract automorphism-group structures, and it relies on the source classification for exhaustiveness.
title: Closed automorphism orders for four infinite quaternary Hermitian LCD classes
